name: kiln
description: Design-system orchestrator. Builds systems that carry a declared lineage and intensity vector instead of collapsing to web defaults, audits/extends existing systems against measured gates, and generates a docs site content model. Its phase-0-through-8 build sequence is enforced by a real state machine (scripts/kiln_state.py) — required carry-forward fields and the Phase 5 approval checkpoint are rejected by code if missing, not just described in prose, and .kiln/state.json is a genuine on-disk record a context reset can reload. A bundled PreToolUse hook (hooks/pre-write-guard.sh) actually blocks writing a token, style, or component file before Phase 5, not just detects it after. Bundles four sub-skills kiln calls into as it works: docs-engine (Bootstrap/MUI-grade docs site generation), spacing-engine (measured spacing gates), form-language (per-component-class form/silhouette derivation from a lineage reference), and variant-foundry (K-candidate generation with a floor-filter + judge-separated-from-generator loop).
